## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete change and affected area.

## Verification

List actual commands/results and any unrun checks. Add fictional screenshots for UI changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and follows the applicable contribution instructions.
- [ ] Meaningful tests/docs/contracts are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private inquiry data, database exports or signing files are included.
- [ ] No production mutation or deployment is required to verify this PR.
- [ ] Third-party assets have appropriate provenance and notices, if added.
